scope: Eight legacy TESR families without a direct 1.21.1 NeoForge BER

findings.summary: Original uses a 12×12 quad mesh sampled from 13×13 grid_amt, additive tint and oscillating perimeter; current BE computes/synchronizes 169-byte grid, but enabled/disabled baked models have no grid render path.
findings.check: Place Dioptra across two aura/flux gradients, switch mode, compare 3D height-field/waves, top and side tints.

findings.summary: Original floats and spins focus slot item, orbiting colored crystal items and additive billboards with two rays each. Current wand_workbench baked model and GUI implement workstation/UI, but no corresponding BER; BE has crystalCosts map and no explicit BE update packet/tag overrides in inspected class.
findings.check: Insert focus, start crafting with >1 aspect crystal, compare hovering focus, orbits, colored billboards/rays; test GUI independently.

findings.summary: Original ModelChest with chesthungry.png, opening lid animation (prevLidAngle/lidAngle). Current baked model is one 14×14×14 oak_planks-textured cuboid; block RenderShape.MODEL and no BER, no lid state in BE. Open/close sound and storage exist separately.
findings.check: Place/open/close Hungry Chest and watch lid, lock/seam, wood/teeth texture and item-eating state from 4 directions.

findings.summary: Original TESR draws blue-tinted ModelTubeValve rod only when matching neighboring transport exists, oriented by tube facing. Current multipart tube_side/tube_core geometry has connection arms but no data-driven rod; TCTubeValveRenderer is only bound to TUBE_VALVE, a distinct BE type.
findings.check: Test one-way tube in all 6 orientations, with and without attached compatible transporter; compare directional blue indicator.

findings.summary: Original TESR renders red/blue valve rods for each connected, open, choked side (two choke modes). Current BE persists openSides/chokedSides and multipart baked model represents arms/central body only; no TUBE_BUFFER BER. VALVE BER does not cover buffer type.
findings.check: Cycle open/choke state 0/1/2 per connected side, rotate tube/neighbor and compare blue vs red rod indicators.

findings.summary: Original TESR draws a face-facing aspect label/tag when filtered, plus ModelBoreBase nozzle for neighboring compatible transport outputs. Current BE persists and syncs aspectFilter/labelFacing; block renders a static model and no ALEMBIC BER, so state-specific overlay and nozzle not represented by inspected resource path.
findings.check: Apply/remove labels on horizontal faces, change aspect, connect/disconnect transport; compare rendered tag, facing and nozzle.

findings.summary: Original ModelCentrifuge renders spinny bit rotated by cf.rotation. Modern clientTick updates rotation/rotationSpeed and block wires client ticker, but baked 6-element static centrifuge model and no CENTRIFUGE BER cannot consume rotation.
findings.check: Run centrifuge with and without essentia, compare rotor rotation, accel/decel timing and sound.

findings.summary: Original TESR draws 10-frame mode atlas indexed by pc.type and two 3D textured gears rotated by pc.rot. Modern BE syncs pattern type and block interaction displays text message, but baked static model and no PATTERN_CRAFTER BER do not render the per-mode icon/gears.
findings.check: Cycle all ten modes, capture facing-dependent icon and compare gears idle/running.

nondefect_notes: Static blockstate/model presence verifies a baked model exists, not visual fidelity.
Legacy one-way tube rod and buffer choke rods are conditionally drawn, so a single unconnected screenshot may not expose the difference.
TCTubeValveRenderer is registered exclusively for TUBE_VALVE: do not generalize it to TUBE_ONEWAY/TUBE_BUFFER.
Dioptra 169 sample values represent a 13x13 mesh whose quads number 12x12.
Focal Manipulator UI implementation does not substitute for its old in-world floating focus/crystals.
Source-only gap means inspected render pathway does not implement old effect; comprehensive runtime visual A/B is still required.
regression_guard: Do not change server logic, resource identity or canonical registry IDs in visual-fix work.
Use dedicated modern BER or client block entity / model data pathway, with client packet sync as needed.
Do not declare V0 accepted without captured original-vs-port A/B scenes.
